control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: injury during a breakdown response on P-4103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-4103, PT-4103 and V-4110 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on P-4103, PT-4103 and V-4110 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-4103 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 1 April 2011 an incident occurred on P-4103, PT-4103 and V-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
